composer-2.5-fast.concept: You scrub through a corrupted traffic-camera reel — tap to freeze glitches before backdoor code loads across the frame.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: tap-to-freeze glitch detection while dragging to scrub frames
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap to lock a glitch, drag horizontally to advance the reel
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one surveillance reel, 30 clean frames, done in under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: glitches multiply and flash faster; decoy clean frames trick your timing
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: CRT green monochrome with heavy scanlines

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Launch a lone agent through a fog bank — hold to aim, release to fire — snatching harness tokens that loosen steering mid-flight.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: hold/release directional launch through drifting obstacles
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: hold to charge angle, release to launch
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: one fog crossing, one perfect arc, 45 seconds flat
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: wind shear bends trajectories; harness pickup windows shrink each segment
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor fog layers over thin wireframe trajectories

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Directives drift down an overcast skyline — swipe them into 'yours' or 'theirs' lanes before the stack overflows.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: swipe left or right on each falling card
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: clear 20 directives before the authoritarian pile tops out
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: paired directives arrive together; ambiguous ones need a double-tap inspect pause
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout brutalist cards on muted gray sky

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw one unbroken line linking dormant agent nodes on your phone screen — lift only when every node pulses green.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: continuous path drawing to connect all nodes
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: drag one continuous path without lifting
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: one thumb, one line, all nodes linked before the circuit times out
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: nodes drift apart each second; dead nodes appear that break the line if crossed
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: neon wireframe nodes on deep indigo overcast
